items.text: Paths in color: each path has its own, on its number in the index and on the controls it teaches
the path numbers on the bar sit under their buttons, in one line; tap one for the path, its next step, and take me there
every step in Paths ends with a link that takes you to the control that does it
steps are circles: empty until done, filled once done
suggestions: the next steps on your paths when you come back, and your progress under the duck-rabbit on the cover; Settings › Suggestions turns them off
hide a section with the crossed eye on its header; Settings › Hidden brings it back, or shows all
Install hides itself inside the installed app; a #install link still opens it
the index in learning order: Guide, Paths, Sound, Bytebeat, Picture, Resources, Install, Settings
Learn is now Resources, with a globe: links out to the web
Paths: six learning paths in the index, each a checklist that ticks itself as you go, with its number on the buttons it teaches
Paths: each path walked unlocks a bonus look; every path walked unlocks a pack of the six toolpaths as G-code
Settings › Paths turns the marks off; save and load your progress
Bytebeat: the box shows the formula with the live slider values filled in while you are not typing
Bytebeat: My formulas, a saved list with names, rename, delete, export and import
Bytebeat: lookup tables (strings and arrays), floatbeat and signed modes, stereo heard as mono, and a clock from 8 to 48 kHz
panels and sections glide over 0.6 s, slow enough to see
panels glide in and out, and index sections fade open and closed, smoothly even while the stage is busy
the capture panel is clean again; video length, intro, outro and fades moved into batch export, where they apply
batch export shows greyed out here until the Artist plan opens
